# semaphore_ex_runtime_secrets (Resource)

Manages configured runtime-secrets state and expiry. Requires the admin-only configured-state GET endpoint. Destroy forgets ownership and preserves the server setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_runtime_secrets" "configuration" {
  state = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `state` (String) Explicit configured lifecycle state. Effective expiry does not rewrite this setting.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC3339 expiry. Omit to remove an expiry. Import retains the configured timestamp even after expiry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity runtime_secrets.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import semaphore_ex_runtime_secrets.configuration runtime_secrets
```
